tests.description: a given name is kept and a missing one is inferred from the file

description: a given name wins over the file name

comment: The spec does not say how a missing name is inferred, only that a name is alphanumerics and underscores. Both libraries slug the file stem: lowercase, camelCase split, other runs of characters become one underscore

tests.description: every inferred name is a valid name

description: names slugged from non-ascii file names
comment: The spec does not decide between transliterating and dropping a non-ascii letter; the proposed answer transliterates it, as the TypeScript library does

description: paths other than a single local file
comment: A multipart resource is named after its first part, and a remote or nested path after its file stem

tests.description: first part, remote stem and nested stem

description: unnamed resources without a file name
comment: The spec does not say how such a resource is named; both libraries list it as resource followed by its 1-based position

tests.description: inline data is named by position

description: several resources with the same file stem
comment: The spec does not require names to be unique, and both libraries infer the same name for each. A name that references a resource is ambiguous then
